headline: Next-12-month demand is forecast at 1,753,111 units (+2.7% vs the last 12 months) and $1,562M revenue (+7.6%).
The 19-month plan is 2,738,798 units / $2.47B.
Supply constraints cost an estimated $82M of unmet demand (81,827 units), led by Semiconductor allocation.

Strongest macro signals: Hydraulic Systems <- ISM Manufacturing PMI (lag 3m, corr +0.92); Electrical Assemblies <- New Vehicle Orders Index (lag 3m, corr +0.91); Chassis & Structural <- Auto Production YoY Pct (lag 2m, corr +0.84)

Forecast shape: Winter 2025-26 was a demand-driven dip (not supply-driven; stockouts were under 0.3% of volume). The forecast returns toward the 2024 level because the model finds no growth driver in the flat macro paths. Mid-2027 to 2028 YoY of -2% to -7% is therefore the least-evidenced part of the plan; use it with the P10-P90 range.

price_effect.note: Announced January list-price rises lift the volume-weighted price by +5.4% over the last known price; revenue therefore grows faster than units in the plan. Price elasticity is not estimated.
